name: Khopra Danda Trek
sub_region: Myagdi and Kaski Districts, Gandaki Province (Annapurna Conservation Area)

difficulty.notes: Sleeping altitude 3,660 m at Khopra; optional Khayer Lake day hike is ~16 km round trip, ~1,000 m up and down, 8-10 h, on a poorly marked rocky trail that can be snow-covered. Without the lake it is moderate. [s4][s5][s6]

duration_days.notes: 5-day ridge loop skips Khayer Lake; 7-9 day versions include the lake and an acclimatisation day. Can be done clockwise (via Ghorepani/Poon Hill, Swanta, Chistibung) or anticlockwise (via Ghandruk, Tadapani, Dobato, Bayeli Kharka). Alternative exit via Paudwar toward Tatopani. [s4][s5][s6]

max_altitude_point: Khayer Lake (Khayer Barah temple); Khopra Ridge 3,660 m is the high overnight

itinerary.notes: Community-run lodge; only one lodge at Khopra, booking advised in high season. [s4]
Start by 5:30-6:30 am; set a turnaround time. Can be replaced by a rest/acclimatisation day. [s6][s7]

itinerary.route: Poon Hill sunrise (3,210 m) - Ghorepani - Ulleri - drive to Pokhara
itinerary.notes: Jeep from Ulleri/Tikhedhunga area to Pokhara. [s4]

best_seasons.notes: Khayer Lake trail can be snow-covered. [s6]

permits.name: Annapurna Conservation Area Permit (ACAP)
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per foreign national (SAARC NPR 1,000), tax included

guide_requirements: 'Khopra Trek' is listed by NTB among Annapurna routes needing a licensed guide via a registered agency since 31 March 2023. [s3] A local guide is also advised because the Khayer Lake trail is poorly marked. [s6]

drives: Pokhara - Nayapul/Kimche ~1.5 h; Pokhara - Ulleri by jeep/bus 3.5-4 h [s4]
logistics.notes: Community lodges at Khopra and Chistibung (income stays with villages). [s4]

highlights: Khopra ridge (3,660 m) facing Dhaulagiri, Annapurna South and Nilgiri, away from Poon Hill crowds [s4]
Sacred Khayer Lake (4,660 m) and Khayer Barah temple [s6]
Option to include Poon Hill sunrise [s4]
risks: Long, poorly marked Khayer Lake day on scree and moraine; snow possible [s6]
Sleeping-altitude jumps of 600-770 m above 3,000 m on some stages [s7]

acclimatization.notes: Recommended 9-day version adds a rest day at Khopra before the lake. [s5]

secondary_keywords: off the beaten path Annapurna trek

unverified: Khayer Lake altitude: 4,660 m in most sources, ~4,645 m in one.
Chistibung altitude: 3,000 m in one source vs ~3,600 m in another.
TIMS requirement in practice (NTB lists it; operators report it is not checked in Annapurna).
